name: SAR 7/24 Sport Platinum
lead: SAR 7/24 SPORT combines the clear, decisive, and professional design approach of Sarsılmaz's latest advanced-engineered pistol series SAR 7/24 with the needs of sporting and competitive platforms.
description: SAR 7/24 SPORT combines the clear, decisive, and professional design approach of Sarsılmaz's latest advanced-engineered pistol series SAR 7/24 with the needs of sporting and competitive platforms.

The flat trigger design with a single-action trigger system and adjustable reset distance gives the SAR 7/24 faster, more accurate shooting, maximum trigger control, and a clearer trigger feel. The frame design specially developed for the SAR 7/24 SPORT is complemented by frame lines that maximize ergonomic grip both during gripping and shooting. Another distinguishing feature of the SAR 7/24 is the square trigger guard. The SAR 7/24, fed with a double-row 17-round capacity magazine, has a barrel bushing mounted on the slide assembly, which increases the feeling of balanced shooting and provides an advantage in rapid firing. SAR 7/24 also offers the user the highest level of shooting performance with its ergonomic structure that takes into account the weight balance factor suitable for the “full size” class. Developed with a Magwell design that facilitates quick magazine changes during firing and improves the weapon's grip, the SAR 7/24 SPORT also provides the user with important advantages such as customization, flexibility, and accuracy in targeting thanks to its adjustable rear sight assembly.
